items.name: rocket/launch
items.title: Rocket Launcher: launch candidate
items.prompt: One shoulder-fired rocket launcher discharge: a compact dry ignition thump immediately followed by a short coarse exhaust rush moving away. Strong physical low-mid punch, distinct mechanical launch, tail quickly clears for other nearby shots. Close clean isolated recording, no voices, no music, no long echo, no laser tone.

items.name: rocket/blast
items.title: Rocket Launcher: blast candidate
items.prompt: One compact rocket impact explosion against heavy industrial masonry: instant hard crack over a deep short pressure thud, then a brief sprinkle of loose grit and small steel fragments. Dry and close, grounded physical weight, no cinematic rising swell, no voice, no music, no repeated explosions.

items.name: foundry/machine_warning
items.title: Foundry: machine warning candidate
items.prompt: Two short separated blunt electromechanical warning buzzer pulses from an old factory machine, low-mid gritty industrial tone, immediate starts and clean stops, useful danger cue above machinery without a piercing high pitch. Dry isolated recording. No speech, no music, no siren sweep, no room ambience.

items.name: foundry/release_latch
items.title: Foundry: mechanical release candidate
items.prompt: A heavy steel safety latch being manually released once: a firm handle clack, restrained spring snap and one short sliding bolt scrape ending in a solid stop. Worn but functional machinery, close dry tactile recording, no door slam, no voices, no music, no echo.
